master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production complete vehicle game master: safety orange all-terrain 6x6 cargo truck, carrying eleven tonnes of heavy ore sacks strapped on the bed, visible through open cargo side. Equipment: expedition box with ladders and lights. Thick dried mud and weathered materials. Approved Swamp Scout premium semi-realistic painted illustration, readable dark contours, rich natural textures, fine mechanical detail. Reference 1 style only; reference 2 strict perpendicular camera and mechanical construction only; reference 3 tire/rim. Facing RIGHT. Exactly 3 near-side ROAD tires: one front steer axle at right and CLOSE rear tandem at left, directly supporting load. All tires 1.62 m flotation tires, huge low-pressure balloon tires with wide paddle lugs. Total length 9.4 m = 5.802 tire diameters, under 16.8 m including load. Secured cargo and all equipment stowed. Horizontal chassis/deck/load, level hubs and tire bottoms. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Real conventional short-bonnet heavy-truck cab; separate bonnet radiator housing blunt bumper headlamp and round-clearance front fender with clean seams. Small rectangular mirror at A-pillar on short rigid brackets. No melted fused wedge panels or floating mirrors. All road tires fully visible; no front grille face or bed end face visible. Wide PNG intended 2048 x 1024, at least 1500 pixels across, generous 5% clear margins ALL sides. True transparent background and internal gaps. Soft even daylight. No text logos watermark ground shadow glow halo scenery.

validation.method: Built-in generated master edited deterministically with painted wheel-well material from Bogmaster body-v3. Alpha repaired; wheel normalized circular and centered; identical wheel composited at each road hub. Unchanged master pixels retained outside listed regions.
validation.sourceHubsMeasuredBy: Native image rim center inspection and lower tire silhouette; final hubs standardized to listed coordinates.
validation.visualReview: Inspected native master, body and wheel: correct load/equipment, conventional plausible cab and mirror/fender, strict side camera, exact road axle count, identical level round tires, no far-side tires, clear margins, opaque upper wells and transparent lower clearance; master/body registration verified by pixel comparison. Light/dark and suspension-drop diagnostics saved.

wheelCenterCorrection.method: Hough hub-cap circle; smooth radial displacement of rim/inner sidewall, zero displacement at outer tread.

finalAudit.alphaEdgeReview: Light/dark and suspension-drop composites saved and inspected; no opaque background, ground shadow or colored fringe.
